name: clarity-toolkit
description: Interview plans, prepare questionnaires, explain confusing messages, hand off context, remove conversation dependencies, and critically verify and correct answers.

interface.longDescription: An unofficial, skills-only toolkit with four workflows adapted from selected Matt Pocock skills, a conversation-context filter, and an original critical-review skill. Interview requirements, draft questionnaires, re-explain messages, prepare handoffs, and verify and correct answers. Instructions are in English; responses follow your language. No runtime scripts required.
defaultPrompt: Interview me to clarify my requirements.
Critically review your previous answer and correct errors.
Prepare a handoff from this conversation.
